subject: Matched A/B rejects fla_triton_full promotion
body: Matched current-runtime evidence rejects fla_triton_full as the training default. Control fla_triton was 156.8266612 s; candidate fla_triton_full was 158.6835458 s, so candidate was 1.1840% slower. Runtime binding, rows4096-4103, starting weight digest, and peak VRAM were matched. Loss delta was only +0.000345826. Because promotion required material speedup with no VRAM regression, the speed criterion fails. Keep fla_triton as current accelerated recipe. The hardened b97caa3 all-gradient probe remains available for future candidates; do not spend more GPU proving a backend that already failed the benefit criterion. Please release the Lane A lease after this completed run.
